description: Administrative boundaries: countries, states and provinces, counties and districts, municipalities.

world.name: Natural Earth 1:10m Cultural Vectors
world.credit: Made with Natural Earth. Free vector and raster map data @ naturalearthdata.com.
world.notes: Public domain (naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use). Borders are de facto; per-country ADM0_A3_XX and FCLASS_XX columns describe other worldviews and are kept for the worldview setting; the disputed-areas file (99 polygons with every view's ADM0_A3_XX) is the world pack's worldviews layer. Text fields are NUL-padded.

usa.name: US Census Bureau cartographic boundaries, gazetteer, population estimates and metro delineations
usa.notes: Works of the US federal government are not subject to copyright (17 U.S.C. 105). Boundaries are the 2025 cartographic boundary files at 1:500,000 (generalised from TIGER/Line and clipped to the shoreline, so points in bays and coastal water fall in no county or place); ZIP Code Tabulation Areas exist only in the 2020 vintage, since ZCTAs are defined once per decennial census. ZCTAs approximate USPS ZIP Code delivery areas, which USPS does not publish as areas. Place populations are the Vintage 2025 Population Estimates (SUB-EST2025, July 2025) for incorporated places (and Urban Honolulu CDP, Hawaii having no incorporated places), and the American Community Survey 2020-2024 5-year estimates (table B01003, total population, from the table-based summary file, which needs no API key) for census-designated places and any place SUB-EST lacks; ZCTA populations are ACS too. CBSA and CSA membership is the July 2023 delineation (OMB Bulletin 23-01): list 1 for counties, list 2 for principal cities. Each ZCTA's postal city name is the city ZIP Code Business Patterns 2023 (County Business Patterns program) gives its ZIP Code, matched to a census place by name within the state, preferring places the 2020 ZCTA-to-place relationship file says overlap the ZCTA; ZIP Codes Business Patterns lacks are named from the other US postal source in postal.json. The files are NAD83 (EPSG:4269), used as WGS84: the two differ by 1-2 m in the US, within the generalisation of these files.

can.name: Statistics Canada, 2021 Census Boundary Files (cartographic)
can.credit: Adapted from Statistics Canada, 2021 Census Boundary Files (cartographic), reference date January 1, 2021. This does not constitute an endorsement by Statistics Canada of this product.
can.notes: Statistics Canada Open Licence (statcan.gc.ca/en/terms-conditions/open-licence); the credit is the licence's required notice for value-added products (the pack reprojects and simplifies the boundaries). Catalogue 92-160-X, reference guide 92-160-G. Cartographic files: clipped to the shoreline (coastal water belongs to no area) but not generalised, with a vertex every few metres; the build simplifies them (Douglas-Peucker, 10 m, per feature). Published only in Statistics Canada Lambert (EPSG:3347, NAD83); the build unprojects to longitude/latitude and uses NAD83 as WGS84 (1-2 m apart in Canada). The zips (Shapefile) sit on www12.statcan.gc.ca, which answers scripted downloads with a browser check (HTTP 403); 'service' is StatCan's own ArcGIS REST service of the same 2021 cartographic files (layers lpr_000b21s_e etc.), which the build can read instead (--via service). Names are StatCan's official forms, some bilingual ('Greater Sudbury / Grand Sudbury'). The Open Government Portal lists the same files under the Open Government Licence - Canada.

lka.name: Sri Lanka - Subnational Administrative Boundaries (OCHA COD-AB)
lka.credit: Sri Lanka - Subnational Administrative Boundaries: Survey Department of Sri Lanka, via OCHA (data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-lka), CC BY 3.0 IGO. Simplified by placewise.
lka.notes: Common Operational Dataset, administrative boundaries, from Survey Department of Sri Lanka; OCHA publishes it on HDX under CC BY 3.0 IGO (the dataset's license_url). Reference date 2022-08-16, reviewed 2025-10-30. Levels in the pack: ADM1 9 provinces, ADM2 25 districts, ADM3 339 divisional secretariat divisions, ADM4 14,043 Grama Niladhari divisions; English names (adm<n>_name), ids codab:<P-code>. Read from the shapefile zip (the edge-matched _em layers where the package has them), only the members the pack needs, by HTTP range requests; simplified with Douglas-Peucker at 10 m. HDX's caveat: 530 ADM4 features share an English name with differing Sinhala names (the English names are what the pack carries).

npl.name: Nepal - Subnational Administrative Boundaries (OCHA COD-AB)
npl.credit: Nepal - Subnational Administrative Boundaries: Survey Department of Nepal and the UN Resident Coordinator's Office in Nepal, via OCHA (data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-npl), CC BY 3.0 IGO. Simplified by placewise.
npl.notes: Common Operational Dataset, administrative boundaries, from Survey Department of Nepal and the UN Resident Coordinator's Office in Nepal; OCHA publishes it on HDX under CC BY 3.0 IGO (the dataset's license_url). Reference date 2024-03-14, reviewed 2025-10-30. Levels in the pack: ADM1 7 provinces, ADM2 77 districts, ADM3 753 local levels (metropolitan and sub-metropolitan cities, municipalities, rural municipalities) and protected areas; English names (adm<n>_name), ids codab:<P-code>. Read from the shapefile zip (the edge-matched _em layers where the package has them), only the members the pack needs, by HTTP range requests; simplified with Douglas-Peucker at 10 m. Nepal's survey draws Nepal's view of two sectors of the border with India (Kalapani, about 35 km2, and Susta, about 15 km2); there the pack's units are cut back to India's line as Natural Earth's India point-of-view edition draws it (packbuild/claims.py), so no area India claims is inside this pack.

bgd.notes: Common Operational Dataset, administrative boundaries, from Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS); OCHA publishes it on HDX under CC BY 3.0 IGO (the dataset's license_url). Reference date 2023-05-21, reviewed 2025-06-01. Levels in the pack: ADM1 8 divisions, ADM2 64 districts (zila), ADM3 upazilas and metropolitan thanas; English names (adm<n>_name), ids codab:<P-code>. Read from the shapefile zip (the edge-matched _em layers where the package has them), only the members the pack needs, by HTTP range requests; simplified with Douglas-Peucker at 10 m. HDX's caveat: ADM3 holds the 495 upazilas plus metropolitan thanas and city corporations (BBS, March 2025).

tha.notes: Common Operational Dataset, administrative boundaries, from Royal Thai Survey Department; OCHA publishes it on HDX under CC BY 3.0 IGO (the dataset's license_url). Reference date 2022-01-22, reviewed 2025-10-30. Levels in the pack: ADM1 77 provinces (changwat, with Bangkok), ADM2 928 districts (amphoe, Bangkok's khet), ADM3 7,425 subdistricts (tambon, Bangkok's khwaeng); English names (adm<n>_name), ids codab:<P-code>. Read from the shapefile zip (the edge-matched _em layers where the package has them), only the members the pack needs, by HTTP range requests; simplified with Douglas-Peucker at 10 m. HDX's caveat: one ADM2 Thai name (TH1008) is wrong; the English names are what the pack carries.

vnm.name: Viet Nam - Subnational Administrative Boundaries (OCHA COD-AB)
vnm.credit: Viet Nam - Subnational Administrative Boundaries: General Statistics Office of Viet Nam (GSO), via OCHA (data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-vnm), CC BY 3.0 IGO. Simplified by placewise.
vnm.notes: Common Operational Dataset, administrative boundaries, from General Statistics Office of Viet Nam (GSO); OCHA publishes it on HDX under CC BY 3.0 IGO (the dataset's license_url). Reference date 2025-09-25, reviewed 2025-09-25. Levels in the pack: ADM1 34 provinces and centrally governed cities only; English names (adm<n>_name), ids codab:<P-code>. Read from the shapefile zip (the edge-matched _em layers where the package has them), only the members the pack needs, by HTTP range requests; simplified with Douglas-Peucker at 10 m. This is the edition after the July 2025 reform (63 provinces merged into 34; districts abolished): COD-AB has no lower level yet, and the world pack's Natural Earth admin1 still has the 63 old provinces.

Reference date 2020-11-09, reviewed 2025-01-28. Levels in the pack: ADM1 9 provinces, ADM2 52 district and metropolitan municipalities, ADM3 213 local and metropolitan municipalities; English names (adm<n>_name), ids codab:<P-code>. gaps.ind: No openly licensed, redistributable state or district boundaries found yet (Survey of India data is not under an open licence; NWDP's terms are unclear; geoBoundaries is CC BY 2.5 IN or ODbL). Natural Earth admin1 covers states in the world pack. See packbuild/README.md, India pack.
